description.value: Little Yunnan Restaurant is a family-owned eatery on Victoria's historic Fisgard Street, run by Yunnanese immigrants who specialize in authentic regional Chinese cuisine. Their flagship dish, Crossing the Bridge Rice Noodle Soup, features a broth simmered for eight hours from pork bone, chicken, and Yunnan ham, served with fresh vegetables and house-made ingredients. It is a welcoming, affordable spot for a restorative sit-down meal after a ride through Victoria.
